meaning:
παίζω
(παῖς), [in LXX: Gen.21:9 26:8, Exo.32:6 (צָחַק pi.); and more frequently (Jdg.16:25, al.) for (שָׂחַק pi. ;]
prop., to play as a child, hence, generally, to play (as with singing and dancing) : 1Co.10:7 (LXX) (cf. ἐμ-παίζω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
